name: DO CONCURRENT Loop
description: Parallel loop with independence guarantee — omp.wsloop in FIR, auto-vectorizable LLVM IR
source:
subroutine do_concurrent_scale(a, b, scale, n)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in)  :: n
  real,    intent(in)  :: b(n), scale
  real,    intent(out) :: a(n)
  integer :: i

  DO CONCURRENT (i = 1:n)
    a(i) = b(i) * scale
  END DO

end subroutine do_concurrent_scale

llvm_ir.content:
; ModuleID = '02_do_concurrent.f90'
source_filename = "02_do_concurrent.f90"
target triple = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"

; The 'unordered' attribute enables LLVM to auto-vectorize this loop
; with -O2: expect <4 x float> operations in vectorized body
define void @_QPdo_concurrent_scale(
    ptr nocapture %0,           ; a(:)
    ptr nocapture readonly %1,  ; b(:)
    ptr nocapture readonly %2,  ; scale
    ptr nocapture readonly %3   ; n
) #0 !dbg !5 {
entry:
  %scale = load float, ptr %2, align 4, !dbg !10
  %n_val = load i32, ptr %3, align 4, !dbg !10
  %n_ext = sext i32 %n_val to i64, !dbg !10
  %guard = icmp sgt i64 %n_ext, 0, !dbg !11
  br i1 %guard, label %loop.ph, label %exit, !dbg !11

loop.ph:
  ; LLVM recognizes this is a safe-to-vectorize counted loop
  ; because the unordered attribute removed the sequential constraint
  br label %loop, !dbg !12

loop:                           ; preds = %loop.ph, %loop
  %iv = phi i64 [ 0, %loop.ph ], [ %iv.next, %loop ], !dbg !12
  %b_ptr  = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %1, i64 %iv, !dbg !12
  %b_val  = load float, ptr %b_ptr, align 4, !dbg !12
  %prod   = fmul contract float %b_val, %scale, !dbg !12
  %a_ptr  = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %0, i64 %iv, !dbg !12
  store float %prod, ptr %a_ptr, align 4, !dbg !12
  %iv.next = add nuw nsw i64 %iv, 1, !dbg !12
  %done    = icmp eq i64 %iv.next, %n_ext, !dbg !12
  br i1 %done, label %exit, label %loop, !dbg !12

exit:
  ret void, !dbg !13
}

correlations.lowering_notes: DO CONCURRENT's independence guarantee is encoded as the 'unordered' attribute on fir.do_loop and hlfir.elemental. This survives all HLFIR→FIR→LLVM passes and enables LLVM's auto-vectorizer to legally apply SIMD transformations.
The element-wise multiply inside DO CONCURRENT body lowers to arith.mulf in MLIR, then fmul in LLVM IR. The 'contract' fast-math flag allows FMA fusion.
